qualificationPolicy: Passing source tests is necessary evidence only. A runtime remains unqualified until the exact installed version/profile, all required common cases, external delivery observations, and Human platform-owner review are recorded.
releaseComparisonPolicy: This harness records the immutable current candidate and its superseded release, but does not perform champion/challenger evaluation or promotion. Paired behavior, adversarial/recovery, runtime, and Human review evidence remain required.
